title: FabriMAE I Trust Myself? Self-Evaluating VLA Action Generation with Markov Attention Entropy
abstract: arXiv:2608.16697v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) integrate visual perception, language instruction, and action generation into end-to-end policies across heterogeneous architectures. However, enabling VLAs to self-evaluate their action generation reliability without external supervision remains a major challenge. Existing methods either rely on expert annotations or estimate uncertainty only from output statistics, largely ignoring internal signals. In this work, we observe that internal visual modality entropy exhibits consistent distinctions between successful and failed tasks across heterogeneous VLAs. translated_title: FabriMAE——我信任自己吗？基于马尔可夫注意力熵的VLA动作生成自评估
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16697v1 公告类型：新 摘要：视觉-语言-动作模型（VLAs）将视觉感知、语言指令和动作生成集成到跨异构架构的端到端策略中。然而，让VLAs在没有外部监督的情况下自评估其动作生成的可靠性仍然是一个重大挑战。现有方法要么依赖专家注释，要么仅从输出统计中估计不确定性，很大程度上忽略了内部信号。在这项工作中，我们观察到，在异构VLAs中，内部视觉模态熵在成功和失败任务之间表现出一致的区分性。尽管VLAs在动作生成架构上有所不同，但我们表明它们共享一个共同的潜在动作生成抽象，该抽象在视觉感知、语言指令和状态输入下演化，我们将其形式化为条件生成马尔可夫链。基于这一公式，我们提出了MAE（马尔可夫注意力熵），一种自评估方法。
tldr: 本文提出MAE（马尔可夫注意力熵），通过将VLA动作生成形式化为条件生成马尔可夫链并利用内部视觉模态熵，实现了无需外部监督的VLA动作生成可靠性自评估。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MAE (Markov Attention Entropy), which formulates VLA action generation as a conditional generative Markov chain and leverages internal visual modality entropy to achieve self-evaluation of VLA action generation reliability without external supervision.
